note: Issue #25: how bodies fall (src/systems/anim/ragdoll.gd). Speeds are m/s, gravity m/s^2 (the game's 20). kick is the push of the killing blow away from whoever landed it, scaled by its damage up to kick_max; kick_up lifts it a little so the body leaves its feet. knee_buckle pushes the knees forward so legs fold. friction and bounce act where a particle touches the world (collision_mask). It sleeps once nothing moves faster than sleep_speed for sleep_after seconds, or after max_seconds. Dropped weapons are thrown with the hand's speed plus weapon_toss.
